name: IAXO / BabyIAXO detector
notes: No placements[] entry recorded: this detector has not yet been sited on a sourced site id this session (facility:desy / site:desy-hamburg-campus are owned by the facilities lead and not yet landed).

summary.plain: The IAXO detector design uses a large magnet aimed at the Sun to catch faint signals from hypothetical axion particles. A smaller version, BabyIAXO, is being built at DESY as a stepping stone to the full-scale instrument.
summary.technical: Purpose-built axion helioscope hardware (double-bore toroidal magnet for full IAXO; a smaller toroidal magnet for the BabyIAXO prototype) with X-ray optics and detectors, currently under construction (BabyIAXO stage) at DESY.

technology.value: Axion helioscope: a purpose-built double-bore (IAXO) / toroidal (BabyIAXO) superconducting magnet tracking the Sun, coupled to X-ray focusing optics and low-background X-ray detectors, scaling up the CAST technique.
